_comment: Backup pointer for the LAST Delegent Hermes runner golden image. 2026-09-18: every account moved to the agent engine (apps/agent), the per-user runners were destroyed and the Fly account closed (Alex's call), so the Fly registry no longer exists. Both images below were copied byte-for-byte to GitHub's container registry first by .github/workflows/runner-image-archive.yml, digests verified after the push, and 'archive' is where to pull them from if the old model is ever wanted again. The other recovery route is unchanged: rebuild from Dockerfile.fly + the pinned Hermes tag in scripts/install-hermes.sh (both committed).

archive.note: Same sha256 digests as 'current' and 'previous' below; pull by tag or by digest.

current.note: The 2026-09-13 combined review release: durable delivery journal, native lifecycle, the compression patch, connector client recovery and the async bridge gate.

previous.note: rolled out on repin; rollback target.

restore: # OR rebuild from source (registry-independent): npm run runner:image:build
